meta.title: Risk register - sanctions, counterparty, operational (HiClaude reseller)
meta.purpose: Consumed by the simulator (sim.*), the pricing engine (risk premium via data in docs), ops (controls/KRIs) and the catalog (label_guidance).

impact.1: minor: <0.5% of equity, no customer impact
impact.2: moderate: 0.5-3% of equity or <1 day degraded service
impact.3: significant: 3-10% of equity or 1-3 days outage
impact.4: major: 10-30% of equity or >3 days outage / product line closed

sim_semantics.probability_per_month: Chance that at least one such event STARTS in a simulated month, before correlation multipliers; draw with the seeded Rng. 'low'/'high' are for tornado sensitivity.
sim_semantics.float_freeze_pct: params {scope, pct (share of the scope's balance frozen), duration_days (null = indefinite), recovery_prob (chance the frozen share is eventually recovered)}; unrecovered share is written off to a counterparty-loss account; frozen share is unavailable meanwhile.
sim_semantics.downtime_hours: params {scope, hours_median, hours_p90} (lognormal fit) or {hours_per_day_unavailable, duration_days}; scope = the capability that is unavailable.
sim_semantics.fine_irt: one-off cash loss/cost: params {kind, amount_usd | pct_of_monthly_revenue | pct_of_monthly_gmv | pct_of_trailing_12m_revenue}; convert USD at the simulated rate.
sim_semantics.demand_multiplier: params {segment, multiplier, duration_days (null = permanent)}; multiplies the arrival rate of that segment.
sim_semantics.fee_change: params {target, delta_pp | delta_pct | multiplier, duration_days (null = persistent)}; target names a price/fee/rate parameter of the pricing engine or world.
sim_semantics.applies_when: Flags the simulator/business config must satisfy for the risk to be active; unknown flags default to inactive.
sim_semantics.correlation_groups: Scenario engines may activate a group: multiply each member's monthly probability by the listed multiplier while the group is active (cap at 1).

condition_flags.uses_designated_exchange: USDT is sourced from an OFAC-designated exchange (not recommended)
condition_flags.uses_otc_desk: fiat-to-USDT leg runs through a foreign OTC desk / exchange house
condition_flags.messenger_channels: Telegram/Bale Mini App channels are enabled

meta.evidence_limits: Likelihood parameters are modelling priors. Anchors with data: Tether freeze rates (BlockSec 2025), OFAC designation cadence (2026), CBI freeze waves. Provider/exchange failure base rates could NOT be sourced in-session (search budget exhausted) and are flagged low confidence with verify_how.
meta.not_legal_advice: Analysis only; confirm with licensed professionals (CLAUDE.md s3.4).

portfolio.note: Sum of monthly probabilities x 12 over always-applicable risks; a rough event-count intensity, not a forecast. Conditional risks (applies_when) excluded.

controls.title: USDT source allow-list
controls.description: Buy USDT only from venues NOT on the OFAC SDN list (daily re-check against data/sanctions_timeline.json 'entities' and the live SDN file); log provenance per lot. Never route funds to hide their origin.

controls.title: SDN address screening
controls.description: Download the OFAC SDN list daily (public data); screen every inbound sender, outbound destination, provider deposit address and held balance; block exact matches; re-screen holdings after each list update. Use commercial analytics only if the vendor lawfully contracts with an Iran-based business (US/EU vendors often cannot) - never via someone else's identity.

controls.title: Tether blacklist pre-check
controls.description: Before every outbound transfer and on every inbound, call isBlackListed(address) on the USDT contract (Tron and Ethereum) and refuse flagged counterparties; poll watched addresses hourly.

controls.title: Float caps per counterparty
controls.description: Provider float <= eps x equity (eps 3-5%); exchange balance <= 1 day of conversion needs; treasury hot wallet <= 2 days of outflow; review weekly (see 05_base_rates.py section 3).

controls.title: Just-in-time top-ups and sweep cadence
controls.description: Fund providers per order batch (<= 4h) not in bulk; sweep idle balances back at least weekly where the provider allows; batch transfers to cut fees; pre-fund a 3-day USDT buffer only in a segregated, screened wallet.

controls.title: Counterparty diversification
controls.description: At least 2 active providers per product line and 2 conversion rails; no single provider > 60% of float; no single rail > 50% of collection.

controls.title: Proof-of-liquidity tests
controls.description: Monthly test withdrawal/refund of a small balance from each provider and exchange; record latency; red if > 72h or refused.

controls.title: Kill switches
controls.description: Automatic pause of a provider/product/rail when a red KRI fires (latency, reconciliation mismatch, new designation naming the counterparty, freeze event); owner-only manual override with audit log.

controls.title: Multi-signature treasury and cold reserve
controls.description: 2-of-3 multisig (Tron account permissions / Safe on EVM) across independent devices and people; reserves in cold storage; hot wallet holds only the JIT amount.

controls.title: Address allow-list with cool-down and dual approval
controls.description: New destination addresses are inactive for 24-72h; allow-list labelled; dual approval above threshold; per-day outflow limits; micro test transfer for new provider addresses.

controls.title: Address-poisoning hygiene
controls.description: Never copy addresses from transaction history; compare full string; use labelled allow-list/QR from the provider dashboard; dedicated signing UI shows full address.

controls.title: Strong authentication
controls.description: Hardware keys/passkeys or TOTP for every privileged account; no SMS-only recovery; Telegram two-step verification + periodic active-session review; separate admin identities from personal ones.

controls.title: Segregation of duties and maker-checker
controls.description: Refunds, card reveals, price overrides and withdrawals need two people above thresholds; append-only audit log (the ledger); rotation and leave policy.

controls.title: Card-detail handling
controls.description: Reveal-on-demand with logging, auto-expiry/redaction after delivery, encrypted storage, minimal retention; no card data in chat transcripts.

controls.title: Incident-response playbooks and drills
controls.description: Runbooks: provider freeze, exchange halt, key compromise, designation event, internet blackout, wrong-address transfer; quarterly tabletop; pre-drafted customer notices.

controls.title: Record-keeping and provenance
controls.description: Retain KYC, orders, fund provenance tags, screening logs, decision records for 10 years (US IEEPA limitation period was extended to 10 years in 2024 - analyst recollection, verify); tamper-evident storage.

controls.title: Customer risk disclosure and refund policy
controls.description: Per-product risk_label and restriction_note shown before payment; explicit third-party-suspension and refund wording; acceptance logged. Never ask or help customers misstate residency.

controls.title: Legal counsel retainer
controls.description: Iranian-law and sanctions counsel: pre-launch opinion, quarterly review of new designations, review of customer terms; documented advice.

controls.title: Multi-feed price oracle and circuit breaker
controls.description: Median of >= 3 independent USDT/IRT feeds, staleness checks, deviation cap, automatic quote suspension; short price-lock TTL.

controls.title: Multi-rail Toman collection
controls.description: Gateway + card-to-card + wallet with per-rail caps and fallback ordering.

controls.title: Business continuity for connectivity loss
controls.description: Offline order queue, status page, SMS/Bale fallbacks, hosting in more than one lawful location, documented degraded mode.

controls.title: Counterparty due-diligence file
controls.description: Per provider/exchange: entity, jurisdiction, licences, ToS snapshot (hash + date), support-response test, review sentiment, written answer on Iran-resident eligibility.

controls.title: Customer USDT inbound disabled by default
controls.description: Do not accept customer-paid USDT until counsel approves a screening policy; Toman rails only. Rationale: most Iranian USDT originates at SDN exchanges.

controls.title: Counterparty-loss reserve
controls.description: Fund a reserve from margin at the modelled expected-loss rate (05_base_rates.py section 4) and top it up after any event.

controls.title: Monitoring and watchlists
controls.description: OFAC Recent Actions and Treasury press feed, Persian-language news, on-chain alerts on provider/exchange deposit wallets, Tether freeze feed; daily digest to the compliance owner.

controls.title: Backup, DR and succession
controls.description: Encrypted off-site backups with restore tests; sealed key-recovery and succession instructions held with counsel; no single person holds all signing authority.

controls.title: Vendor-policy watch
controls.description: Monthly snapshot of each vendor's supported-countries/ToS page (hash + date); alert on change; product label updated accordingly.

controls.title: Card-to-card receipt verification
controls.description: Confirm credit through bank notification/API, not screenshots; fulfil only after settlement; flag duplicate references.

controls.title: Application security hygiene
controls.description: Dependency pinning and review, SAST, WAF/rate limits, secrets in a vault, least-privilege API keys, pen-test before go-live.

controls.title: Data minimisation and encryption
controls.description: Collect only what is needed; encrypt PII at rest; retention schedule; breach-notification runbook.

WAR_ESCALATION.description: Military escalation: shutdowns, cyber-attacks, crisis halts, sanctions and spread shocks cluster together.

SANCTIONS_WAVE.description: New OFAC action cycle (designations, address listings, sector determinations).

FIN_STRESS.description: Currency shock coupling to the macro scenarios of specialist 08.
